method: Authored sources, explicit line/name/end anchors, UTF-16 arithmetic, and established kind/branch contracts. No candidate query outputs used.

states.rawSource:
nui 1
const fixed: number = 2
profile Print
style Seam {
  width: 1px,
}
point A [Seam] = coordinate(x: 0, y: 0)
point B = coordinate(x: 10, y: 0)
line AB = segment(start: @A, end: @B)
curve C = bezier(start: @A, end: @B)
arc D = arc(center: @A, radius: 2, start: 0, end: 90)
text T = label(text: "draft", anchor: none, size: 3)
image I = image(source: "guide.png", origin: (0, 0), scale: 1, angleDeg: 0, mirrorX: false)
module Panel() {
  point Tip = coordinate(x: 1, y: 2)
}
instance panel = Panel()
point = coordinate(x: 0, y: 0)
move(target: @A, dx: 1, dy: 1)
